prose.text: The shared SCIM protocol mechanics are in [[shared.scim]], and the ZPA side is in [[zpa.scim]]. Provisioning choices around SCIM (the alternatives, the directory-sync migration) are in [[zia.ad-integration.provisioning-methods]]. What SAML does to the same users is in [[zia.ad-integration.saml-auto-provisioning]]. The migration flag is in [[zia.authentication.settings:scim-migration-flag]].

purpose.statement: SCIM provisions users and groups onto Zscaler, automatically updates a user's group and department in the Zscaler user database to follow the directory, and deprovisions users deleted from the directory. It can be driven by a custom SCIM client calling the REST API, or by an IdP partnered with Zscaler.

quotes: Automatically updating a user's group and department on the Zscaler user database to reflect changes in your user directory.
Deprovisioning users from the Zscaler database when users are deleted from your user directory.
Firstly, you can use custom SCIM clients to make REST API calls to Zscaler.
Provisioning users and groups onto Zscaler.
Secondly, you can use one of the IdPs partnered with Zscaler.
